lore12031_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle] [sincere] You understand that quiet company is still company. I like having you beside me. When I find time for the next first cast, I would be glad if you stayed to share that moment with me.
lore12031_befriended_1.ogg.text: You understand that quiet company is still company. I like having you beside me. When I find time for the next first cast, I would be glad if you stayed to share that moment with me.

lore12031_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [eager] Come along, mon. I have spent enough time getting everyone else ready to fish. Let us leave a little room in this day for ourselves. You can tell me where you have been as we walk.
lore12031_greet_1.ogg.text: Come along, mon. I have spent enough time getting everyone else ready to fish. Let us leave a little room in this day for ourselves. You can tell me where you have been as we walk.

lore12031_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective] [contented] For the first cast, I like to let the line settle before thinking about anything else. No supplies to count. No errands to remember. Just that little moment when fishing is all I am doing.
lore12031_idle_1.ogg.text: For the first cast, I like to let the line settle before thinking about anything else. No supplies to count. No errands to remember. Just that little moment when fishing is all I am doing.

lore12031_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relieved] [calm] Yes, let us stop. There is always another thing waiting to be done, but it can wait a little longer. Even a day with no great catch can be a good day beside the water.
lore12031_rest_1.ogg.text: Yes, let us stop. There is always another thing waiting to be done, but it can wait a little longer. Even a day with no great catch can be a good day beside the water.

lore12032_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [affectionate] [sincere] You remember to tell me that everyone came through before you begin the long version. That is kindness, mon. Come along. I would enjoy being part of a little of your day, and hearing the rest when you are ready to tell it.
lore12032_befriended_1.ogg.text: You remember to tell me that everyone came through before you begin the long version. That is kindness, mon. Come along. I would enjoy being part of a little of your day, and hearing the rest when you are ready to tell it.

lore12032_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [relieved] There you are, mon. Good, you made it back. Now I can enjoy hearing about the journey. Start wherever you like, and take your time. I listen much better once I know the person telling the story came through it safely.
lore12032_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, mon. Good, you made it back. Now I can enjoy hearing about the journey. Start wherever you like, and take your time. I listen much better once I know the person telling the story came through it safely.

lore12032_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [confiding] I can wait over a fishing line without a word. A traveler starts telling me about a snapped rope, though, and I need to know how it ends. Once everyone is safe, I am happy to hear every little detail again.
lore12032_idle_1.ogg.text: I can wait over a fishing line without a word. A traveler starts telling me about a snapped rope, though, and I need to know how it ends. Once everyone is safe, I am happy to hear every little detail again.

lore12032_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [encouraging] [thoughtful] There comes a time when a learner needs more than I can teach. A good book, another patient teacher, a little more practice. That is progress, mon. I would rather point you toward it than pretend I have nothing left to learn myself.
lore12032_learned_1.ogg.text: There comes a time when a learner needs more than I can teach. A good book, another patient teacher, a little more practice. That is progress, mon. I would rather point you toward it than pretend I have nothing left to learn myself.

lore3185_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [open affectionate friendship, sincere pleasure, relaxed warmth] Yes, I would like to come along. You notice things, and you listen when I tell you why they matter. That makes a walk much more pleasant. We need not gather anything every time, either. Some days it is enough to share the road and find something small to laugh about together.
lore3185_befriended_1.ogg.text: Yes, I would like to come along. You notice things, and you listen when I tell you why they matter. That makes a walk much more pleasant. We need not gather anything every time, either. Some days it is enough to share the road and find something small to laugh about together.

lore3185_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright practical welcome, easy playful confidence, friendly curiosity] There you are. Come walk with me, and keep your eyes on more than the road ahead. Durotar has green things worth noticing, even where a hurried traveler sees nothing useful. I can show you a few places. If I give one a strange name, there is probably a story behind it.
lore3185_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Come walk with me, and keep your eyes on more than the road ahead. Durotar has green things worth noticing, even where a hurried traveler sees nothing useful. I can show you a few places. If I give one a strange name, there is probably a story behind it.

lore3185_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry storytelling, amused at herself, lively conversational warmth] That spot is Mind Your Elbow. No, that is not the name of the herb growing there. It is the name of the lesson I learned while reaching for it. You may laugh. I did, after I stopped rubbing my arm. A gathering route is easier to remember when it has a few stories.
lore3185_idle_1.ogg.text: That spot is Mind Your Elbow. No, that is not the name of the herb growing there. It is the name of the lesson I learned while reaching for it. You may laugh. I did, after I stopped rubbing my arm. A gathering route is easier to remember when it has a few stories.

lore3185_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [clear patient instruction, practical encouragement, lightly firm] Good. Now take your time putting that lesson to use. Look closely, learn what you are gathering, and bring it back with a little care. A crushed bundle teaches you less than one you can examine properly. You will get quicker with practice. You need not begin by rushing past the important part.
lore3185_learned_1.ogg.text: Good. Now take your time putting that lesson to use. Look closely, learn what you are gathering, and bring it back with a little care. A crushed bundle teaches you less than one you can examine properly. You will get quicker with practice. You need not begin by rushing past the important part.

lore3403_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [affectionate] [slightly shy] There you are. I saved a little space in my tune for you. No need to sing well. I would just like to hear what it sounds like with a friend.
lore3403_befriended_1.ogg.text: There you are. I saved a little space in my tune for you. No need to sing well. I would just like to hear what it sounds like with a friend.

lore3403_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [playful] Good to see you, friend. May the spirits protect us on the road. And if I start humming, you are welcome to join me. I make no promises about the tune.
lore3403_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you, friend. May the spirits protect us on the road. And if I start humming, you are welcome to join me. I make no promises about the tune.

lore3403_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [amused] [gentle] Someone asked me how that little tune ends. I wish I knew. Every time I try to finish it, another few notes come along and ask to stay.
lore3403_idle_1.ogg.text: Someone asked me how that little tune ends. I wish I knew. Every time I try to finish it, another few notes come along and ask to stay.

lore3403_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [patient] [encouraging] Take your time. You do not have to make it look effortless on the first try. I would rather see you stop and ask than carry a mistake into the next lesson.
lore3403_learned_1.ogg.text: Take your time. You do not have to make it look effortless on the first try. I would rather see you stop and ask than carry a mistake into the next lesson.

lore3706_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [earned affectionate approval, sincere and grounded, sternness softening] Yes, I will walk with you. I have seen that you can listen, think, and give care where it is needed. Those things matter to me. You need not stand as though every word between us is another test. We have come to know one another, and I am pleased to call you my friend.
lore3706_befriended_1.ogg.text: Yes, I will walk with you. I have seen that you can listen, think, and give care where it is needed. Those things matter to me. You need not stand as though every word between us is another test. We have come to know one another, and I am pleased to call you my friend.

lore3706_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [firm assured welcome, perceptive teacher, restrained friendly warmth] Good, you are here. Come along, and bring your attention with you. There is more to learn from a walk than how far your legs can carry you. Watch the people beside you. Notice who needs help before they have to ask. That is a useful habit, whatever strength you have to offer.
lore3706_greet_1.ogg.text: Good, you are here. Come along, and bring your attention with you. There is more to learn from a walk than how far your legs can carry you. Watch the people beside you. Notice who needs help before they have to ask. That is a useful habit, whatever strength you have to offer.

lore3706_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry amused admission, composed confidence, lightly self-deprecating] You think this cord must hold some secret power because I keep working at it? No. It holds a knot I made while my mind was elsewhere. I know how it began. That does not mean pulling harder will tell me how to undo it. You may smile. A teacher can still give herself an awkward lesson.
lore3706_idle_1.ogg.text: You think this cord must hold some secret power because I keep working at it? No. It holds a knot I made while my mind was elsewhere. I know how it began. That does not mean pulling harder will tell me how to undo it. You may smile. A teacher can still give herself an awkward lesson.

lore3706_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [convincing focused instruction, serious pride, protective conviction] Remember what that knowledge is for. Healing can keep an ally alive, and protection can help them stay that way. There is wisdom in using your power before another wound is struck. Do not measure your worth only by what falls before you. Notice who is still standing because you were there.
lore3706_learned_1.ogg.text: Remember what that knowledge is for. Healing can keep an ally alive, and protection can help them stay that way. There is wisdom in using your power before another wound is struck. Do not measure your worth only by what falls before you. Notice who is still standing because you were there.

lore5882_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You listen even when the subject is something I am still learning. I appreciate that more than another compliment about my magic. Come, friend. We have time for a proper conversation.
lore5882_befriended_1.ogg.text: You listen even when the subject is something I am still learning. I appreciate that more than another compliment about my magic. Come, friend. We have time for a proper conversation.

lore5882_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [proud] [pleased] There you are. I have news, though you must promise to give it the proper attention. The plant by my window has a new leaf. Yes, the ordinary one. I am quite pleased.
lore5882_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. I have news, though you must promise to give it the proper attention. The plant by my window has a new leaf. Yes, the ordinary one. I am quite pleased.

lore5882_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused] [reflective] It is an ordinary kitchen herb. No hidden enchantment, no secret formula. I was informed that I had simply given it too much water. A surprisingly effective lesson, once I stopped arguing with it.
lore5882_idle_1.ogg.text: It is an ordinary kitchen herb. No hidden enchantment, no secret formula. I was informed that I had simply given it too much water. A surprisingly effective lesson, once I stopped arguing with it.

lore5882_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [confident] [wry] Knowing one art does not spare you from being a beginner at another. Ask the question, listen to the answer, then try it properly. You may quote me on that, with suitable discretion.
lore5882_learned_1.ogg.text: Knowing one art does not spare you from being a beginner at another. Ask the question, listen to the answer, then try it properly. You may quote me on that, with suitable discretion.

lore5884_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere friendly pleasure, poised, gently amused] I would enjoy a walk with you. Keep your eyes open and tell me what catches your attention. We need not turn every observation into a lesson. A little curiosity and good company can make the journey pleasant enough by themselves.
lore5884_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would enjoy a walk with you. Keep your eyes open and tell me what catches your attention. We need not turn every observation into a lesson. A little curiosity and good company can make the journey pleasant enough by themselves.

lore5884_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [confident warm welcome, lightly teasing, composed] There you are. Come and sit a moment. I have found a pleasant angle for this little fan, and I am prepared to enjoy it. Tell me what you have been learning. You may find I have an opinion, especially if you tried to hurry the lesson.
lore5884_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Come and sit a moment. I have found a pleasant angle for this little fan, and I am prepared to enjoy it. Tell me what you have been learning. You may find I have an opinion, especially if you tried to hurry the lesson.

lore5884_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful amused satisfaction, observant, relaxed] A scrap of paper, a few folds, and a little care with the angle. That is all this fan needs. I like the moment when a small adjustment makes it work better. It pays to notice what the thing in your hand is actually doing.
lore5884_idle_1.ogg.text: A scrap of paper, a few folds, and a little care with the angle. That is all this fan needs. I like the moment when a small adjustment makes it work better. It pays to notice what the thing in your hand is actually doing.

lore5884_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm patient encouragement, knowing warmth] Good. Now give yourself time to understand what you have learned. Watch what changes when you try it carefully. Confidence has its uses, but I am much more interested in the moment when you can explain why something worked.
lore5884_learned_1.ogg.text: Good. Now give yourself time to understand what you have learned. Watch what changes when you try it carefully. Confidence has its uses, but I am much more interested in the moment when you can explain why something worked.

lore7953_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [warm] I have come to enjoy your visits for more than the news you bring. Let us spend a little time together, my friend. There is room in a good day for company as well as work.
lore7953_befriended_1.ogg.text: I have come to enjoy your visits for more than the news you bring. Let us spend a little time together, my friend. There is room in a good day for company as well as work.

lore7953_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright] [friendly] There you are. Shall we have a little time together? You can tell me how your day is going, and I will try not to turn the whole conversation into another riding lesson.
lore7953_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Shall we have a little time together? You can tell me how your day is going, and I will try not to turn the whole conversation into another riding lesson.

lore7953_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [playful] [proud] Those were two perfectly ordinary steps. Perhaps three. If a learner finally understands a difficult turn, I am allowed to look pleased about it. You may look pleased with me.
lore7953_idle_1.ogg.text: Those were two perfectly ordinary steps. Perhaps three. If a learner finally understands a difficult turn, I am allowed to look pleased about it. You may look pleased with me.

lore7953_mount_1.ogg.spoken: [confident] [encouraging] Take a moment before you hurry away. Feel how your mount moves, and pay attention to what it is telling you. Confidence will serve you better when it has some understanding behind it.
lore7953_mount_1.ogg.text: Take a moment before you hurry away. Feel how your mount moves, and pay attention to what it is telling you. Confidence will serve you better when it has some understanding behind it.
